_doc: Commander DOCTRINE corpus. Each archetype distills a classical military principle into game BEHAVIOR: tuning params + tactical triggers that emit combat_json commands (flock_to/flock_spread/hold/focus/retreat/ally_follow). This is deliberately NOT a quote dump -- raw passages make flavor, not behavior. Source doctrine is drawn primarily from Sun Tzu's Art of War in the public-domain 1910 Lionel Giles translation; the optional 'flavor' field carries at most a short attributed fragment as an in-game callout. The FSMs (commander_ai.c) consume the params; the eventual Blackstar/Prime LLMs consume the same archetype vocabulary so deterministic + LLM commanders speak one command language.

_principles.doctrine: concentrate force where the enemy is weak; avoid strength
_principles.behavior: focus fire the player's exposed flank; commit the squad to one collapsing line rather than spreading thin
_principles.source: Sun Tzu (Giles 1910), Weak Points and Strong

_principles.doctrine: when you outnumber the foe, surround him
_principles.behavior: spread the squad around the player to encircle when the squad is larger
_principles.flavor: If ten to the enemy's one, surround him.

_principles.doctrine: if weaker, be capable of withdrawing; avoid a losing fight
_principles.behavior: retreat and harass when outnumbered or the squad is hurt; refuse the direct engagement
_principles.flavor: If unequal in every way, we can flee from him.

_principles.doctrine: let your rapidity be that of the wind; strike then recede
_principles.behavior: alternate aggressive focus pushes with pull-backs to keep the player off balance
_principles.flavor: Rapidity is the essence of war.

_principles.doctrine: hold out baits to entice; feign disorder then crush
_principles.behavior: hold a tempting exposed line, then focus-collapse on the player when they over-commit to it
_principles.flavor: Hold out baits to entice the enemy.

_principles.doctrine: he wins whose ranks are united in purpose; hold the line
_principles.behavior: keep the squad disciplined at their zones, resist scattering, hold standoff
_principles.flavor: He will win whose army is animated by the same spirit.

aggressor.desc: Presses relentlessly: concentrates the squad on the player, pushes the line forward, rarely yields ground.

surrounder.desc: Uses numbers to encircle: spreads the squad around the player, then closes the ring.
surrounder.flavor: If ten to the enemy's one, surround him.

skirmisher.desc: Hit and run: harasses from range, retreats when pressed, never commits to a losing exchange.
skirmisher.flavor: Rapidity is the essence of war.

baiter.desc: Feigns weakness: dangles an exposed line, then collapses on the player who takes the bait.
baiter.flavor: Hold out baits to entice the enemy.

warden.desc: Holds ground with discipline: keeps the squad in formation at standoff, yields only when badly hurt.
warden.flavor: He will win whose army is animated by the same spirit.
